title: D. Okafor
summary: D. Okafor is a member of the Purchase department who authored amendment AMD-PUR-2026-03 on 2026-10-12.
body:
D. Okafor is a staff member in the Purchase department at Northbridge Cycles [^r1]. On 2026-10-12, Okafor authored [[amd-pur-2026-03|AMD-PUR-2026-03]], an upcoming amendment to the [[pol-pur-001|Purchase Policy]] [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, this amendment has been issued but is not yet in force [^r1].

## Activities

D. Okafor prepared and authored version 1.0 of [[amd-pur-2026-03|AMD-PUR-2026-03]] on 2026-10-12 for the Purchase department [^r1]. The amendment carries an effective date of 2026-12-01 [^r1].

## Versions and conflicts

* **Today's rule**: As of 26 October 2026, [[pol-pur-001|POL-PUR-001]] operates without amendment AMD-PUR-2026-03 [^r1].
* **Future rule**: From 2026-12-01, amendment [[amd-pur-2026-03|AMD-PUR-2026-03]] authored by D. Okafor takes effect [^r1].
* **Kind**: `future_dated` [^r1].

## See also

* [[amd-pur-2026-03|AMD-PUR-2026-03 Amendment 3 to the Purchase Policy]]
* [[pol-pur-001|POL-PUR-001 Purchase Policy]]

r1.quote: 1.0 2026-10-12 D. Okafor Issued; in force from 1 December 2026
